name: SmartWeb Disable Click
author: smartwebtech39

sections.description:
SmartWeb Disable Click by SmartWeb Tech is a lightweight WordPress content protection plugin.
It disables right-click, text selection, copy, F12, and keyboard shortcuts to protect your website content.
The plugin follows WordPress coding standards and includes only GPL-compatible assets.

License

GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-disable-click folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to SmartWeb Disable Click → Dashboard.
  4. Select protections you want to enable.
  5. Click Save Settings.
sections.faq:
Does it work with page builders?

Yes, it works with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, WPBakery, and other major page builders.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Can I customize the message shown on blocked actions?

Yes, you can set a custom message in the dashboard settings, which will appear when a user tries blocked actions like F12 or right-click.
